pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
**Ghost Pepper's got Spain turnin' up the heat while Mustard Boy's got Brazil dippin' in ketchup.**

Devin's over here chillin' with Spain pullin' a 3-0 smackdown on Austria, rackin' up those points like it's his birthday and puttin' Ghost Pepper right on Gunner's tail with 42 points. Meanwhile, Mustard Boy Zach thought draftin' Saudi Arabia was gonna look like a Texas oil strike, but all he's struck is pure fantasy heartbreak. Gunner, aka Bubba G, sittin' pretty at the top with 47 points, probably 'cause he thinks DR Congo's a future champ after a secret chat with his barber. Rafe, "The Noisemaker," should stick to causin' chaos 'cause it looks like he drafted Germany thinkin' they were still contenders when they last were... well, let's just say he could’ve thrown darts at a map and got better picks. Gayden, aka The Backpass Assassin, better pray England's got more than tea bags in their arsenal, 'cause sitting at 31 points ain't impressin' anyone right now. But hey, there's still time for miracles — or for Mustard Boy to finally get his act together.
